description: SQL-ACT-FAIL (prepared definition changed during execution), missing variant: schema changes by a peer while a statement is frozen inside ACE. Participant a runs UPDATE Big SET V = V + 1, Pad = String(100, 'q') with dbFailOnError; participant b suspends a 200 ms after a starts the statement, then on its own shared Database runs, each with dbFailOnError and Errors read: CREATE INDEX IX_Big_V ON Big (V), ALTER TABLE Big ADD COLUMN X LONG, DROP INDEX IX_Big_V ON Big, DROP TABLE Big; then b resumes a. a reports its RecordsAffected and Errors; afterwards the schema (Fields of Big, if the table survives), Count(*) and Sum(V) are read. Follow-up probe (round 2) for SQL-ACT-FAIL, ACT-SEL-03; works on a fresh writable copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-big. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
